scope: Existing GeminiNormalHomeContent NH01 route on ADAPTIVE_V2; preserve native Compose, real data, finite pager, LakeGlass centerCrop, current FishRecord/photo binding, and navigation.

invariants: Hero width:height ratio remains 247:293; width remains 70% of track capped at 337.2dp.
Hero max height 400dp; readable bounds 148dp to 220dp; exact M01 320x480/fontScale1 floor 124dp.
Side card remains at most 82% of Hero width and 66.7% of Hero height, with +15dp top offset.
Keep the existing S/2 equal surplus allocation and every piecewise-linear spacing curve and threshold.
Do not change CaptureVisualTokens, shared motion, assets, backend data, or real record/photo binding.

additional_scenarios: Current connected device: read actual window dimensions, density, insets and font scale from runtime; do not infer from screenshot pixels.
Safe-height boundary pairs: 499/500dp, 699/700dp, 839/840dp, and existing footer 459/460dp continuity probes.
Width-change probes at stable height and font scale; validate piecewise curves and no layout-mode switches.
One real record centers one Hero without neighbors; three unique real records have previous/center/next content and stable IDs.

test_policy.runtime_emulator: Reuse the repository's existing API 28 AVD and run-nh01-api28 workflow. No API 35/36 infrastructure is needed; API 28 runtime screenshots/layout measurements are emulator evidence, not OS compatibility certification.
each_round_requires: ADAPTIVE_V2 responsive formula, Hero ratio, side-card geometry, S/2 and piecewise continuity assertions
all target matrix profiles, font scales and boundary scenarios
page component visual comparison against the private local target
regression check of every previously fixed issue
Run all 12 viewport/font-scale profiles across ADAPTIVE_V2 and V3_BASELINE (24 matrix executions) with the deterministic three_unique_catches fixture.
Capture actual API 28 emulator screenshots and record AVD, screen resolution, density, window bounds, safe insets and FontScale from runtime logs.
test_policy.physical_device: Physical-device acceptance is the user's responsibility and must be reported separately from emulator evidence.

round_policy.per_round: Run the entire matrix, capture actual screenshots, perform full visual diff, enumerate and prioritize all issues, batch-fix, rebuild, and execute the full regression suite.

required_deliverables: All three independent full audit/fix reports and per-round evidence
Complete issue register with unresolved, unverified and blocked items retained
Debug APK plus SHA-256 when a successful artifact exists
PR and exact product-code Commit SHA
Physical-device status reported separately from emulator status
